push.title: L 2-3 vs PCL FC | You: 8.5
push.body:
An 8.5, BellyTb1. You did the little things, and the little things added up.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at PCL FC's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Better key passes than any of their humans (1 vs their best 0). Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (18 vs their best 15). Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Better tackles won than any of their humans (1 vs their best 0). That's growth you can count.

THE BAD
- Match 5 of the session and your rating had slid from 9.7 early on to 8.5. That's where the match slipped.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- 1 tackle won cost 0.1. One thing at a time.
- Worst passes attempted of your 5 matches this session (24). Old coach's advice: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
- Worst goal involvements of your 5 matches this session (2). Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

Teach your feet: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

You're closer than you think. Trust the process, and trust your teammates. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs PCL FC | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9. You've got more in the tank, and we're gonna go find it together.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at PCL FC's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 1). You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Passes attempted 44, up from your usual 34. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.

THE BAD
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Simple as pie: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- Match 5 of the session and your rating had slid from 9.0 early on to 7.9. That needs to look different next time out.
- 4 missed tackles: -0.1. Practice makes permanent.
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 88%+. That's the next rung.
- A one-goal loss (2-3): a single moment decided it. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

Pre-match routine: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Progress over perfection. - Coach Lasso
